newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - November 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - November 6.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Tamil United Liberation Front tries to get support of members of parliament to back demands to include LTTE in future peace talks.
Government says LTTE may have been behind recent killings of two of its own cadres in Paris.
Deputy Finance Minister G.L. Peiris presents third budget aimed at reducing deficit and promoting export-led growth.
Nurses union threatens trade union action if President Chandrika Kumaratunga fails to intervene to settle salary anomaly.
Police question Tamil girl deported from Denmark where she raised funds for the LTTE.
President Kumaratunga dissolves Board of Investment directorate.
Police sets up strike force to combat crime, violence and corruption.
Health Ministry prepares plan to prevent AIDS epidemic in Sri Lanka.
